text: The loop guard, and so its fallback, is Claude Code's alone, narrowing D-0151 and D-0174 (#374): Codex's JSON events can't show the replies the guard counts. codex-cli 0.163.0, which the factory runs, ends the turn at the first reply that reaches the model's output limit. It takes the Responses API's incomplete response, reason max_output_tokens, as an error it never retries, so codex exec emits an error event and then turn.failed, each saying "Incomplete response returned, reason: max_output_tokens", and exits 1. A run never has a second such reply to count, and nothing says what the one it had held: the events mark no reply's end, a failed turn reports no tokens, an agent message or a tool call shows only once the model has finished writing it, and reasoning only as a completed item with a summary, which none of the 184 Codex transcripts in @gitdek's watchers' work directories holds. So a Codex build whose reply reaches the limit fails with Codex's own reason, isn't retried as its provider's failure and doesn't fall back, and -fallback-effort, the watchers' medium included, applies only to Claude Code's builds. Falling back on that failure instead, after one reply whatever it held, would be a new rule for @gitdek to choose.
